text: Singapore is a highly developed city-state, characterised by an overall **cleanliness and orderliness**.
Main roads are often divided, and commonly feature black-and-white curbs and double yellow outside lines. You will often see tall apartment blocks nearby.
NOTE: In many cases, this “general look” is all you need to easily identify Singapore. Nevertheless, we have listed some more specific tips below.
text_zh: 新加坡是一個高度發達的城市國家，整體特徵是**乾淨且有序**。
主要道路經常是分隔道路，通常有黑白相間的路緣石和雙黃線外線。你經常會在附近看到高大的公寓大樓。
注意：在許多情況下，這種「整體外觀」就是輕鬆辨識新加坡所需的全部線索。儘管如此，我們仍在下方列出了一些更具體的技巧。

text: All street name signs in Singapore follow this **unique format**. They are green, with rounded edges and a distinct white font.
text_zh: 新加坡所有的街道名稱標誌都遵循這種**獨特的格式**。它們是綠色的，邊緣圓潤，並採用獨特的白色字體。

text: Most Singaporean licence plates are **black, with white text**. Occasionally, you will be able to see the British style **white-and-yellow** plates and very rarely red plates.
NOTE: Neighbouring Malaysia and Indonesia also use black plates with white text. However, the letters will usually be divided into two or three sections - this is not the case for Singaporean plates.
text_zh: 大多數新加坡車牌是**黑底白字**。偶爾你會看到英式風格的**白黃相間**車牌，極少數情況下會看到紅色的車牌。
注意：鄰近的馬來西亞和印尼也使用黑底白字車牌。然而，它們的字母通常會分成兩到三個區段——新加坡車牌則非如此。

text: Directional signs are also **green**, with white letters and English writing.
NOTE: Expressways each have a **three-letter code** (e.g. TPE), making them easy to spot on signs.
text_zh: 方向標誌也是**綠色**的，帶有白色字母和英文書寫。
注意：每條快速公路都有一個**三字母代碼**（例如 TPE），使得它們在標誌上很容易被認出。

text: Road signs in Singapore are unique in that they are always set on a **square white background**.
NOTE: Road signs in almost all other countries will not have this square background.
text_zh: 新加坡的道路標誌的獨特之處在於它們總是設置在**正方形的白色背景**上。
注意：幾乎所有其他國家的道路標誌都沒有這種正方形背景。

text: **Rain trees** are seen all around Singapore, and are often planted along main roads.
text_zh: **雨樹（Rain trees）**在新加坡各地隨處可見，經常被種植在主要道路沿線。

text: Warnings are often written **on the road** in large letters, such as the famous “HUMP AHEAD”.
text_zh: 警告標語經常以大號字體寫**在路面上**，例如著名的「HUMP AHEAD」（前方有隆起路面）。

text: Singaporean buses are mostly **lime-green**, making them easily recognisable. Other designs can also be found, for example the [white-and-purple SBS Transit variants](https://goo.gl/maps/SXeRNoTSsTqTmy5BA).
text_zh: 新加坡的公車大多是**萊姆綠**的，這使得它們非常容易辨識。也能找到其他設計，例如[白紫相間的新加坡捷運公司（SBS Transit）塗裝款式](https://goo.gl/maps/SXeRNoTSsTqTmy5BA)。

text: Moreover, all bus stops are protected by **concrete bollards** with unique black-and-yellow **warning bands**.
NOTE: Similar, but not quite identical designs are found in some Malaysian cities.
text_zh: 此外，所有公車亭都受到**混凝土路樁**的保護，並配有獨特的黑黃相間**警告條紋**。
注意：在某些馬來西亞城市也能找到相似但不完全相同的設計。

text: In addition to the concrete bollards on bus stops, Singapore sometimes has a unique and yellow **bus-leaving box** with an **arrow** on the street.
text_zh: 除了公車站的混凝土路樁之外，新加坡街頭有時也會出現一個獨特的黃色**公車離站方框**，裡面帶有一個**箭頭**。

text: Almost all Singaporean traffic lights follow this design and are supported by a curved **sheet of metal** containing several **holes**.
text_zh: 幾乎所有新加坡的紅綠燈都遵循這種設計，並由一塊帶有多個**孔洞**的彎曲**金屬片**支撐。

text: Many streets are named after the neighbourhood they are in, especially in the suburbs.

NOTE: These neighbourhood names appear very quickly on the map, so you can save yourself a lot of time scanning for 5k’s that way. For example, the sign in the image refers to Street 31 in the neighbourhood of Ang Mo Kio.
text_zh: 許多街道都以它們所在的社區命名，特別是在市郊地區。
注意：這些社區名稱在地圖上出現的速度非常快，因此你可以省下大量掃描 5k 的時間。例如，圖片中的招牌指的是宏茂橋（Ang Mo Kio）社區內的 31 街。

text: The Tuas planning area is an **industrial area** that is characterised by straight roads, industrial complexes, cranes and shipping containers, making it recognisable.
text_zh: 大士規劃區是一個**工業區**，其特徵為筆直的道路、工業綜合體、起重機和貨櫃，使其極具辨識度。

text: You can easily recognise the **island of Sentosa** thanks to the green signposts, winding roads and general resort feel. Occasionally you might see a green lane like [this](https://goo.gl/maps/hrc9MLAc4F6GQihy5) as well.
text_zh: 你可以透過綠色路標、蜿蜒的道路以及濃厚的度假村氛圍，輕鬆認出**聖淘沙島**。偶爾你也可以看到像[這樣](https://goo.gl/maps/hrc9MLAc4F6GQihy5)的綠色車道。

text: The Generation 3 **trekker on Pulau Ubin** can be identified by the unusually rural forest coverage and the camouflage-type hat sometimes visible when looking down.
text_zh: 烏敏島（Pulau Ubin）上的第 3 代**徒步拍攝**可以透過異常鄉村化的森林覆蓋，以及向下看時有時可見的迷彩帽來識別。

text: You can recognise **St John and Lazarus Islands** thanks to the Generation 3 trekker, the smooth asphalt roads and the sea almost always nearby.
text_zh: 你可以透過第 3 代徒步拍攝、平坦的柏油路以及幾乎隨時在側的大海，來認出**聖約翰島和拉撒路島**。

text: The miniscule Kusu Island is easily identifiable because of the **red paving stones** used for the entire pathway.
text_zh: 極小的庫蘇島（Kusu Island）因為整條步道都採用**紅色鋪路石**而極易辨識。
